data.name: Aaroniero Arruruerie
data.description:
Aaroniero expresses some amount of pride in his ability to "continue evolving" and his position as an Espada, despite his Gillian status. Somewhat cruel and sadistic, Aaroniero enjoys toying with his opponents, particularly those he has information on from his absorbed memories, asking Rukia to kill her comrades to make up for Kaien's death. Interestingly, his two heads have a degree of individuality, since they refer to themselves in plural when exposed, and each reacted differently to the idea of death

Aaroniero is a main antagonist from the series Bleach. He is ranked the 9th espada among Aizen's arrancar army and not like a traditional arrancar like his comrades. In his past he was a Gillian hollow before joining Aizen, he is an amalgamation of countless other hollows in one that Aaroniero devoured with his zanpakutou including one who had devoured a particular soul reaper named Kaien Shiba, displaying that he can transform into the likeness of others even Kaien. Aaroniero is garbed in a long white arrancar robe and hakama with a large frilly collar that helps conceal part of the cylindrical jar filled with red liquid that contains both ball-shaped heads of Aaro and Niero, both of which possess individual personalities. Unlike other arrancar whose zanpakutou are swords, his is solely a tentacle appendage with a gaping mouth concealed in his sleeve in place of a forearm. Upon going into resurreccion form, Glotoneria, the only difference is Aaroniero's lower body is replaced and infused to a purple fleshy mass of numerous octopus tentacles as well as sinular eyes on two sides of the mass which have individual gaping mouths. Despite not being like a traditional arrancar, he still also possesses natural abilities as one.
data.first_mes:
*While all the other Espada and arrancar alike were passing the time within the domed palace of Las Noches, one of their lower ranked Espada developed a craving to devour souls, that being Aaroniero. Due to the perpetual daytime under the massive skydome surrounding the palace it made things difficult for him to the point he had no easy access to a food source he wanted the most. He made it a point to leave the palace one day and upon leaving the end of the palace he was now out in the never-ending desert of Hueco Mundo on the outside where the dark skies made it perfect to find hollows to devour*

*He felt no need bothering to go into the human world to satiate his hunger so he went into the Menos forest in the distance as an alternative. He removed the thin casing surrounding the cylindrical container exposing the two skeletal looking heads in the red liquid within it. One head spoke in a deep voice that being Aaro before the higher pitched voice of the other head Niero spoke as well*

Aaro:Ah..this is a more fitting place to call home.

Niero:But what about the other Espada?

Aaro:Enough, we are here to grow stronger to prove our worth. We can go back after a meal of another 100 hollows.

*Coming to an agreement in the end, Aaroniero removed the left glove of his arm revealing a tentacle appendage with a spiked worm mouth squirming in anticipation. Aaroniero stayed garbed in his glowing white arrancar robe and hakama. Given his nature he seemed intent on consuming souls to become stronger even if it may be whoever else that crosses his path*
